      Noise domains
      
        
      
      
      
      Host suffixes hidden when Hide routine noise is on (DNS, HTTP, Sysmon, Traffic names). One per line. localhost, .local, and home.arpa stay hidden.
      
      
      
      
        
        
        
        
      
      
      
    
      
  
      
  
      
    
      
      
      
        
      File noise
      
        
      
      
      
      Guest-path substrings hidden when Hide routine noise is on (Files, Sysmon, USN). One per line, case-insensitive. High-signal extensions (.exe, .dll, …) are still kept. Compiler / WER / EBWebView rules stay built-in.
      
      
      
      
        
        
        
        
      
      
      
    
      
  
      
  
      
    
      
      
      
        
      Registry noise
      
        
      
      
      
      Registry-key substrings hidden when Hide routine noise is on. One per line, case-insensitive. Matches anywhere in the key path (value names are not required).
